notes.title: Join Origament Playtest!
notes.content:
[h1]About the Playtest[/h1]
This is a technical playtest of an early build of Origament, our physics-driven, origami-themed puzzle platform.
It’s still in development — meaning bugs, placeholder art, and missing polish are part of the charm at this stage.
This build focuses on testing platforming mechanics, performance, and controller support.

The playtest will be distributed via Steam Playtest. It will appear in your Steam Library like any other game, and you’ll be able to jump in at any time during the playtest window.

[h2]📆 Playtest Timeline[/h2]
We’ll start rolling out invites in small waves starting April 7, 2025, gradually letting in more players as we go.
Frequent updates will be pushed through Steam as we fix bugs and tweak things based on your feedback.

📝 To join, just click the "Request Access" button on the Origament Steam page.

We're so excited to welcome early testers into our papery little world — and to hear what you think as Origament takes shape!

Thanks for helping us fold Origament together!
— The Origament Team

notes.title: Introducing Origament: A Paper Adventure!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re so excited to finally introduce Origament: A Paper Adventure, our cozy puzzle platformer that has been a labour of love for quite some time. If you've ever marvelled at the magic of origami or enjoyed the charm of handcrafted worlds, this game is for you!

[previewyoutube=WQTbyCnmfNQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Origament is a physics-driven puzzle platformer where you control a small, sentient piece of paper in a beautifully crafted world. But this isn’t just any paper—it can transform into different origami shapes, each granting unique abilities to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and explore enchanting landscapes.

[b]What to Expect in Origament?[/b]
✨ Transform and Adapt – Fold into various origami shapes to glide, roll, or squeeze through tight spaces.
🧩 Puzzles – Use your abilities to solve creative, physics-based puzzles.
🎶 Relaxing Atmosphere – Immerse yourself in a soothing, story-rich environment with an enchanting soundtrack.
💖 Wholesome Story – Discover the journey of a small paper figure trying to find its place in a vast, delicate world.

And don't forget to Wishlist now for more information!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3448430/Origament_A_Paper_Adventure/
